🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 21, 2026

Sun, in its fall in Libra, holds a trine to Moon, in Aquarius. Both in air, and speaking the same dialect: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon sextiles you from Aquarius: an opening to be reached for. Fire begins, and beginning asks little today. It has held two weeks without changing its terms.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. From Aquarius, Moon cuts across the appetite. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. After four weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Aquarius, and what you hold finds words unforced. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. The Libra chapter closed four weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Aquarius untitled. Sun in Libra squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Water that starts things, billed for starting. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, falls in Libra. Moon in Aquarius sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fixed fire pays to hold on. The hold Jupiter had a week ago is not there any more.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. From Scorpio, Venus makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. From Aquarius, Moon concedes the point early. Cardinal air: the opening move is the cheap one. A week ago Venus was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon squares you from Aquarius, and the cost objects. Water that holds on, charged for holding. Four weeks of Cancer ended, and nothing carried over.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. Sun in Libra makes room for you, and then waits. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The sextile to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Libra, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal earth: the beginning has a price on it. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, is at its lowest in Aries: effort costs double. Moon is in your sign, and distance stops being available. Fixed air: the holding and the held stop differing. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Seven days ago none of this was in place.
